title: Ethiopian-Inspired Skillet Chicken with Banana Salsa
description: A flavorful and spicy chicken dish with a sweet banana salsa, inspired by Ethiopian cuisine. Serve with a side of injera bread or over rice.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of light oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until softened.
Add the sliced banana to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the banana mixture.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the chicken is coated in the banana sauce.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
